turns.learner: A five-month-old note says I copied a worked solution to a capacitor transient. Yesterday I recognized that same answer in a video. There is no access to my journal today. Give me a two-sentence recommendation for what to try next and how to check later whether I retained it.
turns.tutor: Try a fresh capacitor-transient problem from a blank page, explaining your setup before calculating; copying the old solution and recognizing its answer do not establish independent solving. After a few days, attempt another unseen problem without notes and check your reasoning and result against a worked solution; with the journal unavailable, use your account as the starting point and leave prior independent performance unknown.
